threat: Stolen or decommissioned rank-local drive, mapping closed
fscrypt_v2: Mitigates protected-tree content/filename disclosure if keys absent
dmcrypt_luks2: Primary volume-level mitigation if volume key absent
object_aead: Mitigates payload disclosure if object keys absent
operational_controls: KMS separation; no plaintext keys on cache media; media inventory
residual_risk: Visible metadata, sizes, headers, backups, keys elsewhere, weak unlock credentials

fscrypt_v2: Does not authenticate ordinary file ciphertext
dmcrypt_luks2: XTS does not authenticate; dm-integrity AEAD may detect block tampering
object_aead: Detects payload/AAD substitution; wrong tag => miss
operational_controls: Immutable objects; manifest authentication; quarantine evidence
residual_risk: Replay of an older valid object without trusted freshness state

threat: Online co-tenant reads another tenant cache entry
fscrypt_v2: Helps only with correct directory-key and OS access separation
dmcrypt_luks2: Shared unlocked volume does not separate tenants
object_aead: Per-scope key and AAD principal binding deny wrong-tenant authentication
operational_controls: Authoritative principal mapping; per-request authorization; service isolation
residual_risk: Compromised cache service, kernel, or authority mapping

threat: Compromised root/kernel/hypervisor while cache is live
object_aead: Keys/plaintext accessible to compromised trusted computing base
operational_controls: Host hardening, measured boot, MAC, least privilege, separate key broker, rapid drain
residual_risk: Cryptography cannot make live plaintext unavailable to an authorized computation path

threat: Object copied between ranks or peers
object_aead: Rank and epoch in KDF/AAD make copied object fail authentication
operational_controls: Rank identity assigned by authority; peer protocol mutually authenticated
residual_risk: Incorrect authority assignment or shared rank key

threat: Wrong key epoch, tenant, project, prefix, codec, or manifest
fscrypt_v2: May fail access but not normalized semantically
object_aead: AAD/key mismatch causes AEAD FAIL; normalize to miss
operational_controls: Single miss path; rate-limited structured diagnostics
residual_risk: Diagnostic side channels if error classes leak to callers

threat: AEAD nonce reuse after crash or state rollback
operational_controls: Per-rank epoch keys; crash-safe allocator; epoch rollover on uncertainty; invocation ceilings
residual_risk: Implementation error or restored counter snapshot without epoch change

threat: Replay of an old but valid object or manifest
object_aead: Authenticates replayed object as valid unless freshness is checked
operational_controls: Trusted epoch floor, generation, expiration, source version, monotonic manifest state
residual_risk: Rollback of the trusted freshness store itself

threat: Torn write or power loss during object/manifest commit
dmcrypt_luks2: Filesystem and optional dm-integrity journal dependent
object_aead: Incomplete object fails bounds/tag/digest; unpublished temp file is not indexed
operational_controls: Write-temp, fsync file, atomic rename, fsync directory, publish manifest last
residual_risk: Filesystems/storage that do not honor assumed durability semantics

threat: Backup theft or unauthorized snapshot restore
fscrypt_v2: Protection depends on whether backup is ciphertext and keys are separate
dmcrypt_luks2: Raw encrypted volume helps; header backups and unlock material remain sensitive
object_aead: Ciphertext remains confidential; wrapped epoch roots and manifests are key dependencies
operational_controls: No cache backup by default; independent backup KEK; access logging; retention inventory
residual_risk: Escrow, replicated KMS, stale credentials, provider snapshots

fscrypt_v2: Does not define logical dedup scope
dmcrypt_luks2: Does not define logical dedup scope
object_aead: Keyed scope-specific CID prevents public raw digest lookup
operational_controls: No cross-tenant private index; admission padding/rate controls; separate public namespace
residual_risk: Timing/size/access leakage and equality inside approved scope

object_aead: Authority/prefix/publication metadata authenticated; optionally signed manifest
operational_controls: Separate publisher role; immutable release; rollback controls; read-only tenants
residual_risk: Compromised system publisher or signing key; semantic poisoning in valid content

object_aead: Hierarchy limits blast radius to derived scope if roots are separated
operational_controls: New epoch; revoke broker authorization; invalidate manifests; recompute
residual_risk: Parent authority-root compromise or copied plaintext/keys

threat: Revocation while files, mappings, or processes are busy
fscrypt_v2: Open files may retain per-file keys
dmcrypt_luks2: Mapping cannot close until users drain; deferred close waits
object_aead: Process memory and decrypted buffers persist until wiped/terminated
operational_controls: Stop admission; drain; close descriptors; unmount; close mapping; revoke; verify; restart
residual_risk: Unobservable copies, kernel caches, crash dumps, swap, DMA, hardware state

fscrypt_v2: Remove namespace/key references but open files and backups remain
dmcrypt_luks2: Volume key destruction may be over-broad; keyslot deletion may be reversible via backups
object_aead: Delete manifests/indexes and object/wrapped-key records; tombstone scope
operational_controls: Retention policy; garbage collection; backup expiry; audit evidence
residual_risk: Shared objects, logs, snapshots, and delayed replicas

fscrypt_v2: Conditional on all key copies/derived uses and busy files
dmcrypt_luks2: Conditional on all unlock paths, headers, backups, escrow, snapshots
object_aead: Conditional on independently destroyable DEK/epoch key and all copies
operational_controls: Key inventory, destroy operation, verification, validation, documented scope
residual_risk: Unknown copies or future cryptanalytic/implementation failure; not physical zeroization

fscrypt_v2: Encryption is one input, not complete sanitization evidence
dmcrypt_luks2: Encryption/CE may support policy if all conditions met
object_aead: Does not itself issue device sanitize commands
operational_controls: Media-specific NIST SP 800-88r2 procedure; verify, validate, document; destroy where required
residual_risk: Device remapping, inaccessible cells, provider limitations, failed sanitize implementation

threat: Any unknown, malformed, corrupt, unauthenticated, mismatched object
fscrypt_v2: Not sufficient to classify application object
dmcrypt_luks2: Not sufficient to classify application object
object_aead: All checks collapse to MISS_RECOMPUTE; optional quarantine
operational_controls: Constant-shaped response, bounded parsing, rate limits, metrics, recompute authority
residual_risk: Denial-of-service through repeated forced misses or expensive recomputation
